honeymoon.title: Honeymoon welcome gift
honeymoon.description: Celebrating a honeymoon? Enjoy a preferred room location, a bottle of champagne with a remembrance gift, turndown service, and a 15% coupon for Fusion restaurant at the Shops at Alhambra. Enter "Honeymoon" in the Special Service Request at check-out. Travel must occur within six months of the wedding; proof of marriage required at check-in.

hotel.note: An adult 21 years or older must be present in each room at check-in. Inclusions subject to change; some restrictions may apply.
